port.description: TCP port for the management interface

require_auth.description: Require HTTP Basic credentials on routes marked as protected. Defaults to on: a management interface that can reflash the device should not be open by omission.

password.description: Basic-auth password. There is deliberately no default: starting with authentication enabled and no password is refused, so a device cannot ship with well-known credentials.

realm.description: Realm shown in the browser's credentials prompt

max_open_sockets.description: Concurrent connections. A browser holding a WebSocket console open uses one for as long as the page is open.
